rationale: The reporter proposes a new magic value (ALL) for the existing uv audit ignore-until-fixed setting that would bulk-ignore every package without an upstream fix. Per the playbook, the tool behaves as designed today (the per-package workaround works, as the reporter says) and the reporter asks for different or new behaviour, so this is an enhancement, matching the reporter's template label. Nothing points at another tool, the OS or the network, and it is a feature request, so no MRE is needed. search_issues found no true duplicate: #19265 (auto-remove ignore-until-fixed entries once fixed) and #19981 (VEX-based ignores) are related but ask for different things, and #18506 is the uv audit roadmap. search_uv_docs did not return a page for ignore-until-fixed, so the setting was not confirmed in the docs. The example line says 'ruff audit', which looks like a copy-paste slip from the ruff issue and does not affect the classification.
